- **Plot Summary**: The story takes place during a luxurious train journey across Europe. When one of the passengers is found dead in their cabin, Poirot is called in to investigate. - **Twists and Turns**: The film is renowned for its intricate plot filled with multiple suspects and red herrings. Poirot uses his sharp intellect and keen observation skills to unravel the mystery, leading to an unexpected twist that will surprise many viewers.
